name: slider
title: Slider
description: A native range input: a thin well with a pearl thumb.
use: A value from a range where the position matters more than the exact number: volume, opacity, zoom. The browser keeps the keys, the form value and touch dragging.

instead.when: Two values on one scale, such as a lowest and a highest price
The exact number matters and the reader steps it
The exact number matters and the reader types it

keyboard.action: Move the value by one step, as the native range input does; on slider-vertical ArrowUp raises it
Move to the lowest or the highest value

platform.feature: Vertical writing modes on form controls, for slider-vertical
platform.fallback: A browser that cannot turn a range input draws it level, at the length it was given, and it still works
Firefox fills the track natively through ::-moz-range-progress; elsewhere the track stays an empty well and the thumb still shows the value

classes.name: slider
classes.description: A range input: a thin well with a pearl thumb, filled with ink before the thumb

classes.name: slider-vertical
classes.description: Upright, with the lowest value at the foot: writing-mode: vertical-lr and direction: rtl turn the native input, so ArrowUp raises the value. Its length is the height it is given, or the platform's own

properties.name: --slider-background
properties.description: What the track is painted with under the fill: a color or a gradient, such as a color picker's hues
